title.narrative: Environmental Management Strengthening Program for the MVOTMA
Fortalecimiento de la Gestin Ambiental del MVOTMA

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a la mejora de la gestin de la calidad y sostenibilidad ambiental, a travs del fortalecimiento del MVOTMA y en el marco del Plan Ambiental Nacional para el Desarrollo Sostenible (PANDS) y los planes de accin de cuenca. El programa tiene dos objetivos especficos: (i) fortalecer las funciones de planificacin estratgica, evaluacin, control y monitoreo ambiental del MVOTMA; y (ii) fortalecer la gestin integrada de cuencas prioritarias con nfasis en la disminucin de cargas contaminantes de origen agropecuario.

The general objective of the program is to help improve management of environmental quality and sustainability through strengthening of the MVOTMA and through the framework of the National Environmental Plan for Sustainable Development (PANDS) and the watershed action plans. The program has two specific objectives: (i) to strengthen the functions of strategic planning, evaluation, control, and environmental monitoring within the MVOTMA; and (ii) to strengthen integrated management of priority watersheds, with emphasis on reducing pollutant load from agricultural sources
